'''Bread''' is a [[Products|product]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 4.

It is mostly used to make burgers, sandwiches, toasts and hot dogs.

Like all [[products]], it is stored in the [[barn]].

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Making bread'''===
[[File:Bakery.png|150px|left|link=Bakery|Bakery]]
Bread is made in the [[Bakery]].

To make the bread, players need the following ingredient, in the specified quantities:
{| border="0" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="1" style="text-align: center; margin: .5em 0;"
|-
|[[File:Wheat.png|75px|link=Wheat|Wheat]]
|-
|'''x3'''
|}
It takes 5 minutes to make one loaf of bread, and 4 minutes in a fully [[Masteries|mastered]] machine. Each loaf gives players 3 {{Infoicon|xp}} points.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling bread'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Bread can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 216 {{Infoicon|Coin}} for 10 loaves.
* Buying the ingredients required to make bread costs 9 {{Infoicon|Coin}}.

{{Clr}}
----

----
==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|link=Boat|Riverboat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 4 to 27 loaves of bread per crate, up to a total of 81 per boat.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* While bread can occasionally be found in the [[Daily Dirt]] you shouldn't count on buying it there. It is a much sought-after item which will be sold very quickly.
----
